name: knowtether
description: Work with AI on grounded articles, presentations, research reports and books. Short tasks stay light; complex writing receives selected KPDM passages and limited checks.

interface.shortDescription: 和 AI 一起，写得有据、讲得清
interface.longDescription: 和 AI 一起写工作汇报PPT内容、文档、学术报告、知识文章及工具书。短任务只给轻量指导，复杂写作按需读取随包KPDM选段；关注来源、独立判断、适用时的MECE与自然表达。提供有限告警，不保证语义正确、移除统计水印或生成排版文件。需要Python 3.10+并信任Hooks。
defaultPrompt: Use KnowTether to draft a grounded knowledge article.
Review this report's claims, sources and limitations.
